steps.description: Begin your trek through the Pale Heart and search for Crow.
Join Cayde and Crow in Refuge of Repose.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Repose.
Listen to the radio at Refuge of Repose.
Search for the wreckage of Ikora's ship.
Reunite with Ikora and Cayde at Refuge of Silver Wings.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Silver Wings.
Listen to the radio at Refuge of Silver Wings.
Press further ahead through the Pale Heart and look for Zavala.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Home.
Listen to the radio at Refuge of Home.
Scale the treacherous ice wall with Cayde and Crow.
Discuss the next move with Ikora, Zavala, and Crow.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Beginnings
Listen to the Radio at Refuge of Beginnings
Attempt to commune with the Traveler in the Broken Deep.
Attempt to commune with the Traveler in the Forgotten Deep.
Attempt to commune with the Traveler in the Blooming Deep.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Beginnings.
Listen to the radio at Refuge of Beginnings.
Clear a path through a blighted pass, and uncover a long-buried past.
Crow is going to try to talk Zavala down. This may not end well.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Wishes.
Help Targe find Zavala, before it's too late.
Support Zavala at Refuge of Endings.
Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Endings.
Confront the Witness in the place where it was made.
Confer with Ghost in the Lost City.
Complete the "Destined Heroes" quest.
Complete The Hunt Quest
The final shape looms. There isn't much time to prepare.
Confront and unmake the Witness.
Return with Ghost to the Lost City in the Pale Heart.
Confer with Ghost in the Lost City.
There's a strange radio transmission coming from the old Tower in the Lost City… and it's using a Hive frequency.
Investigate the activity of Savathûn's Lucent Hive near the portal.
Speak to Micah-10 through her conduit in the Arbor of Light.
Talk to Cayde-6 in the Lost City.
Ghost has something he wants to talk to you about. Go to the ledge of the old Tower in the Lost City to speak with him.
Talk to Ghost to begin the quests "Lost in the Light" and "Found in the Dark." Work with your allies to explore the possibility of synergy between Light and Darkness.
Investigate spikes in Taken energy in the Refraction.
Go to the Lost City and confer with Ghost.
Use the Dyadic Prism to access the new landing zone in the Sacrarium and claim your destiny.
Defeat foes of the Traveler wherever they're found.
Defeat combatants using your abilities or Super.
Complete the quest "A Guardian Rises" while you wait for the schematic to finish processing the data.
Bring the schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
Cross the threshold and discover what lies within the Traveler.
Defeat targets while using any Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle.
Deliver the completed schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
Find a manifestation of Darkness in the cave in the Seclusion.
Investigate Shadow Legion activity in the Transgression.
Return to the cave in the Seclusion and commune with the Darkness.
Destroy Shadow Legion mining operations in the Divide.
Paracausal ripples have unearthed a manifestation of Darkness.
Find a manifestation of the Light in the cave in the Refraction.
Uncover House Salvation's operations in the Blooming.
Return to the cave in the Refraction and commune with the Light.
Launch "The Hollow, Part II" to travel to Europa and eliminate the Wrathborn threat.
Paracausal ripples have unearthed a manifestation of Light.
Search for Ghost telemetry in strike "The Disgraced" in the Cosmodrome.
Search the Cosmodrome for Peach.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in "Nightmare Hunt: Fear" on the Moon.
Explore beneath the Moon's surface to search for Link.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in strike "Lake of Shadows" in the EDZ.
Search the EDZ for Dejana.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in strike "Insight Terminus" on Nessus.
Search Nessus for signs of Bean.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in mission "Dark Monastery" in the Dreaming City.
Search the Dreaming City for signs of Akasha.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in "Heist Battleground: Mars" located on the Throne World map.
Search Mars for signs of Citrine.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in mission "The Communion" on Europa.
Search Europa for signs of Anwar.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Search for Ghost telemetry in strike "Devils' Lair" in the Cosmodrome.
Search the Cosmodrome for signs of Hecate.
Return to the Arbor of Light in the Pale Heart to restore the lost Ghost.
Return to the Arbor of Light to discuss next steps.
Complete campaign missions on Cooperative Focus mode.
Return to the Arbor of Light.
Explore the search area to find the missing, possibly injured, Ghost.
Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
Speak with Micah in the Arbor of Light to assess the injured Ghost's wounds.
Acquire a Flickering Blessing mod by opening chests anywhere in the Pale Heart. Pathfinder field assignment chests have a massively higher chance of granting Traveler's Blessing mods.
Equip the new Flickering Blessing.
Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
Speak with Micah in the Arbor of Light to discuss your new connection with the Light.
Open Overthrow chests in the Landing to gain access to the location Micah indicated.
Follow the vision of Light into the depths of the Pale Heart and fight the infection found there.
Return to the Lost City's Arbor of Light.
Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
Speak with Micah in the Arbor of Light to assess the injured Ghost's recovery.
Investigate an unknown threat with Cayde and Crow.
Listen to the radio transmission in the Lost City Tower.
Speak to Cayde-6.
Dual Destiny completed
